title: Connector: deshalb
summary: Explaining consequences and linking ideas in everyday speech.
whyItMatters: Deshalb lets you connect a reason or situation to its result without repeating the full explanation.

mentalModel.title: Reason first, result second
mentalModel.content: The first sentence gives the situation; deshalb introduces what follows from it.

mentalModel.title: Deshalb occupies position one
mentalModel.content: The finite verb comes immediately after deshalb in a main clause.

ruleBlocks.title: Use verb-second order
ruleBlocks.content: Say Deshalb komme ich später, not Deshalb ich komme später.

ruleBlocks.title: Express a consequence
ruleBlocks.content: Use deshalb for therefore or that is why, not to introduce the original reason.

ruleBlocks.title: Link complete clauses
ruleBlocks.content: Use a period, semicolon, or comma where appropriate before deshalb.

tables.title: Deshalb Sentence Pattern
rows: Deshalb kann das Treffen dort stattfinden.

examples.de: Ich habe um neun Uhr einen Termin. Deshalb fahre ich früher los.
examples.en: I have an appointment at nine. Therefore I am leaving earlier.

examples.de: Die Kollegin ist krank, deshalb übernehme ich ihre Aufgabe.
examples.en: The colleague is ill, so I am taking over her task.

examples.de: Der Workshop war interessant. Deshalb möchte ich wieder teilnehmen.
examples.en: The workshop was interesting. That is why I want to participate again.

commonMistakes.reason: The finite verb stays in second position.

commonMistakes.correct: Use weil for the reason and deshalb for the consequence.
commonMistakes.reason: The connectors point in opposite logical directions.

comparisons.summary: Workday changes provide natural reasons and consequences.
Deshalb helps justify reactions to plans.
